# Narration Audio Fixtures (P3)

Deterministic, valid WAV files (8 kHz, mono, 16-bit digital silence)
generated with the Python standard library — no FFmpeg, no TTS engine.
Filenames follow the provider lookup rule: `{scene_id}.wav`.

**These prove narration-resolution mechanics only. They are synthetic
silence placeholders, NOT real TTS output, and carry no licensing claim.**
